issues.description: --tiny extraction still unconditionally requires data/stories/manifest.json, but the repo ships an empty story corpus.
The advertised tiny end-to-end test fails on a fresh checkout because required story inputs are missing.
The documented tiny CPU demo is not runnable from the checked-in repository state.
stories_dir is resolved relative to the process cwd instead of the config file, making CLI behavior cwd-dependent.
Validation loads vector artifacts but recreates the backend from CLI config without checking backend, layer, or d_model compatibility.
Preference validation also trusts vector artifacts without compatibility checks before matrix operations.
The HF backend loads the full model in default fp32 and then moves it to one device, which is fragile for the default Gemma model.
HF inference has no truncation, batching, or max-length guard, so long stories can exceed context limits or OOM.
Preference logits are single good-minus-bad scores, not true pairwise preference comparisons as the README claims.
The configured steering.min_reported_emotions value is ignored and the code hardcodes four steered emotions.
The neutral_corpus config option is ignored; extraction always uses the built-in neutral transcripts.
Extraction lacks validation for empty or invalid emotions, topics, and stories_per_cell, leading to late crashes or invalid outputs.
Context validation assumes every configured emotion has a built-in scenario and does not handle empty scenario sets.
The method says stories can be generated, but no story-generation command or implementation exists.
